title: Meerkly worker WebSocket protocol frames
description: Canonical shape of every frame on the worker<->gateway WebSocket (/v1/connect). Go source: api-gateway/internal/model/device.go. Mirrors: meerkly-desktop src/main/gateway/gatewayClient.ts + fetchFrame.ts, meerkly-android gateway/GatewayClient.kt + FetchFrame.kt, meerkly-headless src/gatewayClient.ts + fetchSpec.ts. Changing a field here means changing all of them — the conformance vectors fail otherwise.

register.description: Worker -> gateway, first frame after connect.

region.description: Ignored by the gateway: the worker's region is derived server-side from its gateway-observed IP (GeoIP, lowercased ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code) so workers cannot pick their own region. Kept in the schema for wire compat; workers send "".

deviceToken.description: Issued at device registration (account app). Mandatory: missing/invalid -> error frame device_auth_failed.

fetch.description: Gateway -> worker crawl job. waitFor arrives already resolved (never empty on the wire from a live gateway), but workers MUST still default empty -> 'stable'.

finalUrl.description: null when navigation never committed (e.g. rejected URL). Go unmarshals null into the zero value.

title.description: null when no page was loaded.

response.description: The captured document. Page HTML, or the raw body when `format` is `json`.

format.description: How to read `response`. `json` means the server sent a JSON media type and the raw body is returned verbatim rather than the browser's rendered viewer.

html.description: DEPRECATED: renamed to `response`. Still accepted from workers predating the rename; remove once every deployed worker sends `response`.

loadedMs.description: null when the job failed before a load time was meaningful.

waitTimedOut.description: Condition not met within budget; html is best-effort.

matchedRule.description: Index of the wait_rules rule that matched, -1 = none/fallback.

httpStatus.description: Main-document HTTP status of the crawled page; 0 = not captured (earns 0 credits, never a false payout).

error.description: Gateway -> worker terminal/retryable error before close.

code.description: device_auth_failed = terminal (pair the device first); verification_unavailable = retryable (back off + reconnect).
